warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.setting: A compact home dining table staged for a candid vertical rice review, with practical cookware and food close-ups rather than a polished studio set.
warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.surface: One continuous medium-warm brown natural-wood tabletop with a matte finish, fine straight grain running away from camera, and a softly rounded front edge.
warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.backdrop: Deep green broad houseplant leaves fill most of the distant background, with a small cluster of dark red berries and one amber glass vessel off to the right.
warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.lighting: Soft warm window light enters from the front-left, creating gentle highlights and short soft-edged shadows with a neutral-warm white balance.
warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.palette: Warm brown wood, deep botanical green, warm ivory ceramics, pale rice and restrained dark-red accents.
warm-wood-greenery-rice-table.fixed_props: A shallow pale rattan tray, one warm-ivory ceramic rice bowl, dark charcoal chopsticks and one warm-white rice cooker appear only in the shots that require them.

clips.subject: Royal Umbrella rice is introduced through raw grains, a cooker reveal, cooked rice and a natural two-hand grain close-up.
clips.action: Follow four exact hard-cut shots: falling raw grains, a lid reveal, cooked rice in the cooker, then both hands lifting uncooked grains.
clips.performance: Hands move with casual uneven timing, realistic finger pressure and slight smartphone micro-sway; no face appears.
clips.intention: Create an immediate raw-to-cooked contrast and tactile hook while keeping the target pack secondary until later.
